candidate_workaround: Set the Python standard-stream encoding to UTF-8 before emitting frozen titles that may contain Māori text.
failure_signature: The first semantic-title probe returned partial matches and then stopped with a cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError while printing a frozen Māori title.
recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 before every Unicode-emitting Python diagnostic and give partial output zero completeness credit.
rollback: Retain the partial probe with zero novelty credit and change no proposal until a complete UTF-8 witness passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner text-output recovery only; no scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Māori-authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Pin UTF-8 before frozen-title diagnostics
trigger_preconditions: A Python diagnostic may emit non-ASCII frozen titles under Windows PowerShell.
